ground_rule: Every Y is computed by tools/southern_residents.py from tools/ground.py (the canonical heightmap, rounded). The only Ys in this file are the RECORDS of what the heightmap gives (pokemon.anchor, npc.feet, bbox) and the generator refuses to build when one disagrees: other builders check their collisions against them.

residents.name: Grandmother Cap's ring
residents.kind: a named Pokemon with a trap for a trigger: the folk tale is the warning
residents.situation: On the flat mushroom heath of the Fungal Isle's south half stands a perfect ring of red-and-white toadstools, ten blocks across, on a band of dark podzol. Inside it sit three more, small, and one big one. Islanders and ferry crews leave the ring alone, and someone has put up signs to say so. The big one is Grandmother Cap, an old Amoonguss who has sat in the middle of her own decoys for as long as anyone has rowed past. She is asleep until somebody steps over the ring: the trigger is the ring itself (trigger 9 against the ring's radius of 10), so the warning on the sign is exactly the rule.

site.measured: 2026-10-03 from tools/ground.py: y144 at the centre and at every sample of a 97-block square round it (143..145; the Fungal Isle's south half is a flat heath, data/regions.json fungal_south, painted mushroom_fields, docs/world-building/REGIONS.md Fungal Isle). tools/water_mask.py: dry. Route paths: the nearest is about 1,050 blocks away (the isle has none); the nearest x/z authored in another data file is about 190 blocks away (tools/southern_residents.py --report).

pokemon.name: Grandmother Cap
pokemon.message: The biggest cap in the ring turns round. It has a face.
pokemon.level_why: the place's tier is 3 (data/encounter_design.json tables.fungal_south), whose ceiling is 35; L34 sits above the cap a player can hold before gym 3 (data/trainers.json gym_ace_levels[2] = 30) and within the cap after it (gym_ace_levels[3] = 35): the level-cap refusal (data/level_cap.json) is its catch gate, per thrower, as Codex's residents' is (data/resident_encounters.json build.catch_rule_mechanism). Amoonguss evolves from Foongus at 39 in the main series; an old one sitting at 34 is a wild Pokemon's level, not a trainer's
pokemon.trigger_why: the ring's radius is 10 and the trigger 9: crossing the ring and taking a step is what wakes her, and anyone who reads the sign and stays out never meets her
pokemon.reward: capture itself; no item (Codex's rule: no_loot_drops)
